title: Perfect coefficient reduction admits coherent comparisons
statement: Use [def-weil-pbc-residue-exchange-comparison-interface]. Assume at every scheme T that the restricted residue regular module in degree zero is dualizable and that integralReduction followed by restriction has the stated left-derived tensor counit and universal property. There exists a coherent family of pull isomorphisms such that the direct-image comparisons, defined as mates of their inverses, are isomorphisms for all morphisms. No boundedness, finite type, properness, base-change square, or constructibility conclusion occurs.

source.place: Lemma 6.5.9(3), Proposition 6.8.11(3), Remark 6.8.15; explicit formal coefficient and adjunction argument

proof.text: Use the projection normalization theorem to obtain coherent pull comparisons c, a strong monoidal structure on each integral derived pullback, the source tensor identification s, and the input-side identification e. Construct the target isomorphism as the proved c.restrictPushIso at reduction of K followed by Rf_* applied to e. The stated identity then conjugates the restricted push component to the projection map.

Apply the proved Adjunction.isIso_rightAdjointProjectionMap_app_app_of_isDualizable to hPerfect Y and the actual pull-push adjunction. The derived integral module category admits a braiding. The normalized projection map is invertible, hence so is the restricted component of c.push f after cancelling the target isomorphism.

For every degree, the exact scalar-restriction homology comparison identifies homology of the restricted component with restriction of its homology. Forgetting the module action detects isomorphisms, so the original component is invertible. Apply NatIso.isIso_of_isIso_app.

lean.statement:
theorem integralResidue_comparisons
    (hPerfect : ∀ T : Scheme.{u},
      IsDualizable ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0).obj
        ((Mod.comap (coefficientMap (integralReductionMap ℓ E) T)).obj
          (Mod.regular (condensedRingObj
            (Profinite.continuousMapRingObj.{u} (integralResidue ℓ E)) T)))))
    (hTensor : ∀ T : Scheme.{u},
      ∃ ε : DerivedCategory.Qh ⋙ (integralReduction ℓ E T ⋙
            (Mod.comap (coefficientMap (integralReductionMap ℓ E) T)).mapDerivedCategory) ⟶
          Functor.mapHomotopyCategory
            (MonoidalCategory.tensorLeft
            ((Mod.comap (coefficientMap (integralReductionMap ℓ E) T)).obj
              (Mod.regular (condensedRingObj
                (Profinite.continuousMapRingObj.{u} (integralResidue ℓ E)) T)))) (.up ℤ) ⋙
            DerivedCategory.Qh,
        Functor.IsLeftDerivedFunctor
          (integralReduction ℓ E T ⋙
            (Mod.comap (coefficientMap (integralReductionMap ℓ E) T)).mapDerivedCategory)
          ε (HomotopyCategory.quasiIso
            (Mod (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology T) Ab.{u + 1})
              (condensedRingObj (integralCoeff ℓ E) T)) (.up ℤ))) :
    ∃ c : IntegralResiduePullComparisons.{u} ℓ E,
      ∀ {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y), IsIso (c.push f)
